001: It's three thirty in the afternoon.
It sure did. Do you have any plans tonight?
Yes, I do. I'm having dinner with Fernanda at eight.
How nice! Have a great time.
002: Do you know what day it is today?
It's already the fifteenth? The month is going by fast.
I know. Did you already book the appointment?
Yes, I did. It's on Friday morning.
Great, that way you'll get it sorted out soon.
003: What time do you wake up on the weekends?
I usually wake up at nine, sometimes at ten.
Lucky you! During the week I wake up at six.
Wow, that's really early. Don't you get tired?
At first it was hard, but now I'm used to it.
I see. The important thing is to have a routine.
004: Are you going to the party on Saturday?
Yes, I am, but I can only get there after ten.
Because I work until nine and I still need to get ready.
Oh, that makes sense. Will the party go on late?
Yes, it will, so no problem.
005: What's the best day for us to meet up?
For me, Tuesday or Thursday afternoon works well.
I prefer Thursday, because on Tuesday I have my English class.
Sounds good. Where do we meet?
We can meet at that café near your place.
006: Did you see the time? It's getting late.
It's already eleven thirty, I didn't even notice.
I need to wake up early tomorrow, I'd better head home.
That's true, I also have an appointment at eight.
Then I'll call a ride-share car.
Good idea. Anyway, we'll talk tomorrow.
007: How long does it take to get to downtown?
By subway, it takes about forty minutes.
It takes longer, almost an hour and a half.
Then I'll take the subway, it's faster.
Good choice. Just avoid rush hour, it's really crowded.
008: What time do you usually have lunch?
Usually at noon, but today I had lunch later.
Because I had a meeting that ended at almost one.
I see. I prefer to have lunch early, before twelve.
Everyone has their own pace, right?
009: What day do you get back from your trip?
I come back on Sunday night, my flight arrives at ten.
Are you going to work on Monday?
Yes, I am, but only in the afternoon, because I sleep a bit in the morning.
Good idea. That way you rest and still enjoy the day.
Exactly, it's the best way to start the week.
010: Do you know if tomorrow is a holiday?
No, tomorrow is a regular day. The holiday is only next week.
Oh, that's a shame. I thought it was tomorrow.
But on Monday you can take the day off to rest.
That's true, I'm already counting down the days.
Me too, a day off is always good.
